description: Provisional CRWA journeys based on the user guide reviewed in 2024 and the inspected website and API. Confirm current behavior with operators and tests.

journeys.title: Load and validate arrangement and collateral data
journeys.goal: Prepare source data for the reporting period before moving to adjustments.
prerequisites: The source files have been placed in the appropriate data load location

steps.title: Start each available import
steps.action: Choose the play action for each available arrangement or collateral file.
steps.expected: The file is processed and its status becomes Complete when there are no outstanding issues.
alternatives: An incomplete import requires investigation before continuing.

steps.title: Review and resolve validation failures
steps.action: Open the file details, inspect validation failures, and either correct values or record a reason for not correcting them.
steps.expected: Reload corrected data; once all failures have been dealt with, the file can become Complete.
alternatives: Corrections can apply to matching failures or individual rows.
The guide says reasons alone do not require a reload.

journeys.title: Run and monitor a calculation
journeys.goal: Calculate credit risk results for the current reporting period.
prerequisites: Arrangement and collateral data have been loaded
An appropriate reporting period is open

steps.title: Prepare adjustments
steps.action: Review arrangement and collateral additions and updates; load or exclude adjustment types as appropriate.
steps.expected: The screen shows the state of adjustment types and any pending items.
alternatives: The guide describes excluding all adjustment types for an initial calculation without adjustments.
A new Arrangement Add may require completed collateral adjustments to be revalidated; confirm current behavior.

steps.title: Start the calculation
steps.expected: A calculation is requested and progress can be monitored.
alternatives: A rerun warns that the previous calculation will be overwritten.
The confirmation can warn about pending adjustments being excluded.

steps.title: Monitor progress and outcomes
steps.action: Review the displayed calculation steps and durations.
steps.expected: The screen presents the current progress and queued, successful or failed state.
alternatives: The guide describes reviewing calculation output in the database; verify whether this remains current.

journeys.title: Finalise a reporting period
journeys.goal: Complete the reporting period once the calculation and adjustment requirements are satisfied.
prerequisites: Adjustment types meet the displayed requirements

steps.title: Confirm finalisation
steps.action: Choose Finalise and confirm the reporting-period action.
steps.expected: The reporting period is finalised; the UI presents the appropriate follow-on state.
alternatives: Warnings explain conditions that prevent finalisation.
A finalised period can offer a Reopen action subject to conditions.

components.title: Angular website
components.responsibility: Presents operator screens, sends requests and displays progress and validation results.
relationships: Uses the calculation and reporting-period services to call the API.

components.title: Credit risk API
components.responsibility: Exposes import, calculation and reporting-period operations.
relationships: Receives requests from the website and delegates work through application handlers.

components.title: Background processing
components.responsibility: Runs queued import and calculation processing outside the web request.
relationships: The API and website expose progress and results of background work.
